paragraphs: R' Tanhum bar Pappa asked R' Yose, and so forth. He said to R' Mana, “Sign,” and he signed. He told R' Berekhiah, “Sign,” but he did not wish to. He asked, “Why did you not sign?” He answered, “Did R' Yaakov bar Aha not say in R' Mana's name …?” He said, “Had you not signed, they would have said, ‘A pupil disagrees with his teacher’”: Jerusalem Kiddushin 3:14.
